body:
That looks like an Ale bug to me. It tries to access the first element of an apparently empty list: https://github.com/w0rp/ale/blob/master/autoload/ale/job.vim#L39

Please report it to the Ale bug tracker.
sure, but still it would be useful if nvim would not crash on these errors, wouldn't it?
Yup, I missed the crash bit. Crashes are always Neovim bugs, of course.
thanks! I'll still open the issue on ALE repo, maybe that's faster to fix until the nvim crash is solved.

body: btw just in case it might be useful, I had another crash which wrote some different errors: maybe that `tv_copy` might help pinpointing the bug

Huh, `tv_copy()` was called with an unknown variable type. That certainly should never happen.

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/249bdb07dd3a9555972deff625d67e4ee0eddc86/src/nvim/eval/typval.c#L2130-L2133

If you have time, it would be great if you could compile Neovim from the git repo (master branch) and see if it still happens. If so, a [stacktrace](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/wiki/Development-tips#debugging) would be perfect. :)

Since you're on Mac, just checking the `Console` app (`User Reports`) would be good enough for starters. It should contain a stacktrace.

I'm already using nvim compiled from master. I'm using `brew install --HEAD neovim`

I suppose I have to compile it differently to have a stack trace, right?
